goal: Add a new output::agent submodule (crates/monokl/src/output/agent.rs) that adapts MonoklError to michi::DomainError and SymbolsResult/SearchResponse to michi TOON rendering, plus the Cargo.toml dependency shape that adopts michi as a git-rev-pinned, cli-feature-gated dependency.
architecture: One new file, output/agent.rs, built bottom-up: string-level helpers (cell/opt_cell escape michi-toon's newline-deletion defect; symbol_kind_str/visibility_str supply camelCase strings neither enum exposes on its own) before the two trait families that consume them -- ToonProjection<const N: usize> (a compile-time row-arity guarantee, implemented for SymbolsResult and SearchResponse, rendered via render_projection()) and ToDomainError (implemented for MonoklError, covering the 13 variants that exist today; the Io variant is a separately tracked, already-documented blocker). All 17 SPEC-010 acceptance criteria are either testable Rust behavior inside this new module or empirical claims about michi's own pinned-rev source, independently re-verified against the real michi checkout (not merely cited from the spec) before this plan was written.

deferred_criteria.scope: the "io" monokl_code() string only. monokl_code() as implemented (T-010) covers all 13 MonoklError variants that currently exist -- walk, regex_build, non_utf8_path, too_many_terms, tokenizer_init, json, path_outside_root, stale_disk_cache, invalid_git_ref, git, symlink_rejected, file_too_large, lock_poisoned, exactly as AC-007 specifies for those 13 -- and T-010's own match is exhaustive with no wildcard arm, so it cannot silently omit a 14th variant; it simply has no 14th variant to omit today.
deferred_criteria.reason: AC-007 requires "io" as a 14th distinct string, one per MonoklError variant including Io. MonoklError::Io does not exist in crates/monokl/src/error.rs today -- verified by direct read: the enum's own top-of-file comment states the variant is BLOCKED pending the io-errors crate's creation (io-errors does not exist on disk at ../io-errors, and no .cargo/config.toml configures its pinned `registry = "orin-cargo"`), and PLAN-001 (SPEC-001's own implementation plan) already deferred this exact gap via .claude/blockers/SPEC-001-io-variant.md. Adding a monokl_code() match arm for a variant that does not exist would not compile. Once the io-errors blocker resolves and MonoklError::Io is added, monokl_code()'s match becomes non-exhaustive at that point (a real compile error, not a silent gap) until a follow-up task adds the "io" arm -- the exhaustiveness check itself is what prevents this deferral from being forgotten.

deferred_criteria.scope: the "Io -> a fan-out" clause only. The Walk -> walk_error_code(source) fan-out AC-008 also specifies IS implemented in full (T-009, T-010), including the ignore::Error 9-variant exhaustive classification AC-009 requires.
deferred_criteria.reason: Same root cause as AC-007's deferral: MonoklError::Io does not exist, so to_domain_error()'s own match (T-010) has no Io arm to write -- its exhaustive match over the 13 real variants is itself the proof no such arm is missing today. When Io is added, to_domain_error()'s match becomes non-exhaustive until a follow-up task adds the FileIoError::io_source()/io::ErrorKind fan-out AC-009 also specifies for that half.

deferred_criteria.scope: the Io half only (FileIoError::io_source() and its io::ErrorKind fan-out to NotFound/Forbidden/ExternalFailure). The Walk half -- ignore::Error's own 9-variant exhaustive classification via innermost_walk_error()/walk_error_code(), including the nested-Glob-inside-WithPath-inside-WithLineNumber shape a real malformed .gitignore line produces -- IS fully implemented and tested (T-009, T-010), independently compiled against real ignore 0.4.33 before being locked into this plan.
deferred_criteria.reason: AC-009's Io half depends on MonoklError::Io existing and on FileIoError (owned by the not-yet-existing io-errors crate) being a real, constructible type -- neither is true today. This plan's error adapter does not invent an undocumented stub FileIoError, matching the same discipline SPEC-001/PLAN-001 already applied to this exact gap.

feat(monokl): impl ToDomainError for MonoklError (AC-007, AC-008, AC-010, AC-011, AC-012)

Covers the 13 MonoklError variants that exist today -- Io is a
documented, separately-tracked blocker (.claude/blockers/
SPEC-001-io-variant.md). Preserves classification via a monokl_code()
prefix, flattens the full source chain into hints (DomainError itself
never exposes source()), and forces retryable(false) unconditionally
since nothing this crate does locally and synchronously is legitimately
agent-retryable.

reasoning: Before drafting, independently re-verified every michi-side empirical claim SPEC-010's own acceptance criteria make against the real michi source at the pinned commit (cb355b8c05048e71e7219af8416c475346b6f837), available locally at ~/Projects/michi (a git worktree was checked out at the exact pin rather than trusting HEAD). Confirmed exact and unchanged from what the spec states: AC-001 (crates/michi-toon/src/escape.rs's escape_value treats '\n'/'\r' as no-ops -- a literal `'\n' | '\r' => {}` match arm, deleting rather than escaping); AC-003 (crates/michi-toon/src/lib.rs's list() function, including the exact `if fields.is_empty() && !obj.is_empty() { fields = obj.keys().cloned().collect(); }` guard and the resulting zero-length-row RowLengthMismatch consequence -- also confirmed list() itself requires the "serde" feature, which this track's own locked Cargo.toml line does not enable, so AC-003 is discharged in this plan by proving this module never calls list() at all, T-008's grep step, not by a live re-test of list()'s own behavior); AC-004's exact debug_assert! citation (crates/michi-toon/src/render.rs:140-147, confirmed byte-exact including line numbers); AC-004B's entire step sequence (ToonOptions::new's Vec<String> parameter type, not &[&str]; ToonOptions::total_count's Option<usize> vs AgentResponse::total_count's plain usize -- two different signatures on two different builders, confirmed by reading both structs directly; AgentResponse::render_toon() being a real method that calls finish_text, which appends hints, unlike the standalone free function); AC-008 through AC-012's DomainError/ErrorCode/RecoveryHint/KvValue shapes (ErrorCode's exact 9 variants and Conflict's own doc comment "Resource state mismatch."; DomainError::new/.hint()/.recovery()/.retryable() builder signatures; RecoveryHint::new(tool).param(key, KvValue).reason(reason); Error::class()'s exact logic showing retryable overrides default_class()); AC-013 (Value::Null's Display impl writes nothing, and escape_value("") returns Cow::Borrowed("") unchanged -- both render as the identical empty cell); AC-014 (AgentResponse::toon_body()'s internal validate() call exists but its failure only ever affects body text, confirmed by reading response.rs directly -- to_call_tool_result()'s is_error and render_json()'s isError both read only the separate is_error field, set exclusively via as_error()); AC-015 (the exact `features = ["miette"]` -> `michi-core/miette` wiring in michi's own root Cargo.toml, and default = [] confirming default-features=false is a genuine no-op as the spec itself already states). All of this was verified from real source, not documentation, per this track's own stated discipline -- I was able to fully, independently confirm michi's actual API surface at the pinned rev; no claim in the resulting plan rests on the spec's own characterization alone. Separately, and NOT flagged by the spec itself: reading crates/monokl/src/error.rs directly (not assumed from SPEC-010's own text, which describes MonoklError as having 14 variants) revealed MonoklError currently has only 13 variants -- the Io variant is a real, already-documented, already-deferred blocker from SPEC-001/PLAN-001 (.claude/blockers/SPEC-001-io-variant.md), not yet resolved. SPEC-010's AC-007/AC-008/AC-009 are written as though MonoklError already has all 14 variants (a reasonable assumption when SPEC-010 was drafted, since SPEC-001 is the cited source and appears "complete and gated", but SPEC-001 was gated with the Io variant explicitly deferred, not implemented). Writing a match arm for a nonexistent enum variant would not compile, so this plan resolves the contradiction the same way PLAN-001 already resolved the identical contradiction one level down: via deferred_criteria, narrowly scoped to exactly the Io-shaped portion of each affected criterion, with the remaining 13/14ths of each fully implemented and tested. This is a genuine spec/reality gap worth surfacing explicitly to whoever reviews this plan, not a plan defect -- the alternative (inventing an undocumented stub FileIoError/MonoklError::Io just to satisfy AC-007's literal '14 distinct strings' wording) would contradict this track's own non_goals, which explicitly treats MonoklError::Io as an already-typed variant it does not invent. The isolated fixture built to verify this plan (T-003's one-time setup, reused through T-010) mirrors error.rs and the needed types.rs subset directly from the real, already-gated source files (not a frozen transcription) and vendors michi as a real git dependency at the pinned rev -- every task boundary in this plan was independently compiled and its exact test-pass count (7, 9, 9, 9, 9, 13, 15, 27) reproduced live in this session before being written into the plan's own verification steps, including one real bug this process caught (a slice-boundary error that pulled ErrorContext's own doc comment into the wrong task, producing a genuine 'this doc comment doesn't document anything' compile error) -- caught and fixed before being written into this plan, not discovered by a downstream exit-gate.
